decisions: Weak signals are grouped by topic, kind, direction and lead/lag hint so semantically different indicators are not merged.
Repeated signal IDs are ignored to prevent double-counting; evidence and technique IDs are merged as stable sorted unions.
Combined strength and confidence use a bounded independent-support formula, 1 minus the product of remaining uncertainty, capped to 0..1.
Aggregation is deterministic, local and dependency-free; no external sources or model calls are introduced.
risks: The independent-support formula can overstate confidence when signals are correlated; correlation-aware evidence weighting is deferred.
Signals with empty IDs are not deduplicated because no stable identity exists.
